Education · Batch of 2029

B.E. Computer Science & Engineering (Cybersecurity)

J.J. College of Engineering and Technology

I work at the intersection of cybersecurity, embedded IoT systems, and edge AI—focused on taking ideas from circuit schematics and firmware all the way to full-stack deployment. Currently pursuing my Bachelor of Engineering in Computer Science and Engineering (Cybersecurity) at J.J. College of Engineering and Technology (Batch of 2029), I split my time between security research, custom hardware prototyping, and competitive hackathons.

As a freelance IoT and software developer, I architect connected hardware ecosystems using platforms like the Raspberry Pi 5, ESP32, and NVIDIA Jetson Nano. My recent engineering work spans real-time embedded computer vision (using OpenCV, MediaPipe, and YOLO on RT-patched Linux kernels), custom PCB schematic design in KiCad, 3D enclosure modeling in FreeCAD, and full-stack web applications.

On the leadership and community front, I serve as the Technical Lead for Team ALTIUS, driving rapid prototyping and system architecture for national competitions including the Smart India Hackathon and MSME Idea Hackathon. I also serve as an Ambassador for the FUEL User Group India chapter (associated with Palo Alto Networks) and actively build technical initiatives like Altius, Spectra and Laptus.

Backed by specialized training and certifications across ISC2, Cisco Networking Academy, AWS, and Anthropic's AI ecosystem, I am always looking to collaborate on challenging problems in offensive/defensive security, embedded Linux, and intelligent hardware.

Core Focus Areas:

  • Embedded & IoT: ESP32/NodeMCU, Raspberry Pi 5, Custom Sensor Integration, KiCad 7, FreeCAD
  • AI & Computer Vision: OpenCV, YOLO, MediaPipe, Local LLM & Agentic Workflows (MCP, Ollama)
  • Cybersecurity: Penetration Testing, Web Security, WebAuthn, Network Auditing
  • Full-Stack Web: Java (Servlets/JSP), Python, Modern Web UI, Progressive Web Apps (PWAs)

Selected work

Projects & explorations

A selection from my IoT, security, and software work. Concepts and in-development projects are labelled individually.

Digital Acoustic Target

IN DEVELOPMENT

Exploring impact localization through five sensor channels, signal conditioning, and an ESP32-based processing pipeline.

ESP32-WROOM-32Signal conditioningPCB design
Inside the project

The goal is to turn acoustic sensor signals into useful target feedback. Current exploration centers on a five-channel signal-conditioning PCB, reliable event capture, and coordinate estimation. Calibration and repeatable accuracy testing are essential next steps.

VigilDrive

PROTOTYPE

A driver-drowsiness prototype connecting eye-closure detection with a microcontroller-driven audible alert.

PythonOpenCV + dlibESP / NodeMCU
Inside the project

The prototype uses facial landmarks and an eye aspect ratio to identify sustained eye closure, then sends an alert to the microcontroller. ESP32-CAM integration is an exploration direction. Lighting, camera placement, and false alarms need validation; this is a learning prototype, not a certified safety system.

Cloud Voice Assistant

IN DEVELOPMENT

Exploring a cloud-first voice assistant for Tamil and English, connecting speech recognition, language models, and speech output.

Python + FastAPIJavaScriptSpeech APIs
Inside the project

A browser-based interface designed around a speech-to-text → language model → text-to-speech pipeline. The aim is to reduce reliance on local GPU hardware while improving bilingual interaction. Latency, service limits, and transcription quality remain key design considerations.

Explore the GitHub repository ↗

SensorTrust

CONCEPT

An idea for adding a fault-detection layer to simple sensor systems, so questionable readings can be flagged before they drive decisions.

IoTData validationFault detection
Inside the concept

The proposed approach checks sensor readings for implausible values, sudden changes, or unresponsive behavior. The focus is affordable hardware with useful software checks. Detection rules and performance still need to be established through a working prototype.

Smart Irrigation System

PROJECT

An agriculture-focused project exploring how sensing and automation can support irrigation decisions.

IoTAgricultureAutomation
Inside the project

The project centers on smart irrigation and the connection between physical conditions and system response. It forms part of my broader exploration of practical, sensor-based applications.

Air Drawing

PROJECT

A computer-vision project exploring drawing through hand gestures, using a camera as the input interface.

PythonOpenCVMediaPipe
Inside the project

The idea connects hand tracking with an on-screen drawing canvas. Python, OpenCV, and MediaPipe provide the foundation for exploring touch-free interaction and translating gestures into visual output.
